name: Reelkar

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background: warm cream in light, plum night in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar, the desktop sidebar and inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the story box, empty thumbnails, progress tracks, skeleton loaders.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and toasts that sit above surface-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and around cards. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, chip and secondary-button borders (3:1 or better on surface and surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Plum ink: primary text and icons on surfaces and tints.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Saffron as a fill: hero cards, the splash screen. Same in both themes; pair with on-brand (plum), never white.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and hero fills (6.5:1 on saffron).

tokens.name: on-brand-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on brand and hero fills.

tokens.name: hero-start
tokens.usage: Top-left of the hero gradient (marigold).

tokens.name: hero-end
tokens.usage: Bottom-right of the hero gradient (saffron).

tokens.name: hero-ring
tokens.usage: The decorative ring on hero cards.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Deep plum for the tab bar, sidebar and alert cards like 'Your reel is ready'.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on deep.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: The wordmark and screen titles.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Chilli: the main button on a screen (Make reel, Post).

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action (4.6:1 light, 6.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Mint: AI and success highlights (Ideas tile, +views chips, progress fill).

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a teal fill.

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Mint as text.

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: Selected chips, the active tab pill, the active sidebar row, info banners. Ink or teal-text on it.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Chilli as a fill for illustrations, thumbnails and badges.

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a coral fill.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Chilli as text: links and 'See all'.

tokens.name: coral-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a win or recording banner. Ink text on it (or #7a2a17 in light theme).

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Marigold: wins, streaks, confetti.

tokens.name: on-pop
tokens.usage: Text and icons on pop.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Ready, Posted and done states, always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low credits, a platform needing reconnect, a post waiting for approval. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed states and destructive actions, always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px, on every control.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs, and the round play button over thumbnails (white icon on it).

families.display: "Bricolage Grotesque", Hind, "Noto Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.body: Inter, Hind, "Hind Siliguri", "Hind Madurai", "Hind Guntur", "Noto Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Onboarding, celebration and empty-state headlines. Bricolage Grotesque covers Latin; Hindi and other Indic scripts fall back to Hind at the same weight.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles, one per screen. Desktop page titles too.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Section headings, card titles, sheet titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: मिया बारिश के बाद पानी के गड्ढों में रंग ढूँढती है…
styles.usage: The story box, scripts and anything people type. 1.65 line height leaves room for Indic vowel signs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your reel will be ready in about 2 minutes.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small Latin labels above sections. Indic and Arabic have no capitals: use caption at 700 instead.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Durations, timecodes, scheduled times in the calendar. Tabular digits.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; chip rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips, list rows and small cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side margins and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections; desktop card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page margins; top of screen to title.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Onboarding and empty-state separations.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Thumbnails in lists, badges, calendar slots.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, cards, reel thumbnails, sidebar rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners), dialogs and the main create card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the active tab pill.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on phones and tablets.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons on phones.

tokens.name: button-height-compact
tokens.usage: Buttons on desktop and web with a mouse (pointer: fine).

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Phone bottom tab bar, plus the device's bottom safe area.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop and web sidebar at 1024px and wider; collapses to 72px icons from 768px to 1023px.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Desktop and web top bar with search, credits and profile.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the desktop content column.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: From here: icon sidebar replaces the bottom tab bar; two-column grids.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: From here: full sidebar with labels; three-pane layouts (list, editor, preview).

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: From here: the calendar shows a full week with previews; the reel grid goes to 5 columns.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Cards that float over surface (reel cards, the create card).

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, the tab bar, menus and dialogs.

direction: Masala Pop: saffron, chilli and mint on cream (light) or plum night (dark).
